title: Use a structured Seedance prompt with labeled blocks like [SCENE]…
content:
Use a structured Seedance prompt with labeled blocks like [SCENE], [REFERENCES], [TECHNICAL], [STRUCTURE], [TIMELINE], [PHYSICS], [LIGHTING], [AUDIO], and [LOCKS] to control story, visuals, and constraints.

For character consistency, attach separate reference images per character and specify reproduce 100% appearance only, and explicitly tell Seedance not to inherit reference background, lighting, or camera.

Use a separate environment reference image for light/atmosphere only (not geometry/objects) to keep the set consistent while preventing unwanted style bleed.

Lock animation to specific performance channels (eyes, mouth, tilt only) and explicitly forbid locomotion (never walk, hop, or fly) to prevent extra body motion.

Pre-plan the edit by specifying segment count and cut type (e.g., 13 segments, 12 hard cuts) and list each shot with timestamps to force pacing and continuity.

Control camera language by declaring exact focal/angle presets per shot type (e.g., 84° wide, 47° medium at 30–60 cm, 35° close, one 18° macro) and add a no zooming rule.

Prevent style drift by stating what it is NOT (NOT photoreal, NOT live action, NOT stop-motion, NOT illustration, NOT anime) alongside the desired look (high-end stylised 3D feature quality).

Add physically based render cues (soft global illumination, PBR, subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, volumetric light shaft) to steer Seedance toward high-end CG lighting/materials.

Specify motion physics rules (ceramic weight, rock/settle with real mass, no light bouncing; hinge-weight door swing; steam curls; dust drifts) to get believable secondary motion.

Constrain the world with explicit locks (exactly two characters come alive; only a single hand/forearm shown; no text/logos/watermarks; nothing breaks/drops) to avoid unwanted additions.

es.content:
Usa un prompt estructurado de Seedance con bloques etiquetados como [SCENE], [REFERENCES], [TECHNICAL], [STRUCTURE], [TIMELINE], [PHYSICS], [LIGHTING], [AUDIO] y [LOCKS] para controlar la historia, los elementos visuales y las restricciones.

Para mantener la consistencia de los personajes, adjunta imágenes de referencia separadas para cada personaje y especifica que se reproduzca solo el 100% de la apariencia, indicando explícitamente a Seedance que no herede el fondo, la iluminación ni la cámara de la referencia.

Usa una imagen de referencia del entorno por separado solo para la luz y la atmósfera (no para la geometría ni los objetos) para mantener coherente el set y, al mismo tiempo, evitar una contaminación de estilo no deseada.

Bloquea la animación a canales de interpretación específicos (solo ojos, boca e inclinación) y prohíbe explícitamente la locomoción (nunca caminar, saltar ni volar) para evitar movimiento corporal adicional.

Planifica previamente la edición especificando el número de segmentos y el tipo de corte (por ejemplo, 13 segmentos, 12 cortes duros) y enumera cada plano con marcas de tiempo para forzar el ritmo y la continuidad.

Controla el lenguaje de cámara declarando presets exactos de focal/ángulo por tipo de plano (por ejemplo, 84° gran angular, 47° medio a 30–60 cm, 35° primer plano, un macro de 18°) y añade una regla de no hacer zoom.

Evita la deriva de estilo indicando lo que NO es (NO fotorrealista, NO live action, NO stop-motion, NO ilustración, NO anime) junto con el aspecto deseado (calidad 3D estilizada de alto nivel, tipo largometraje).

Añade indicaciones de renderizado físicamente basado (iluminación global suave, PBR, subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, volumetric light shaft) para orientar a Seedance hacia iluminación y materiales CG de alto nivel.

Especifica reglas de física del movimiento (peso cerámico, caer y asentarse con masa real, sin rebote ligero; balanceo de puerta con peso en la bisagra; remolinos de vapor; polvo flotando) para lograr un movimiento secundario creíble.

Restringe el mundo con locks explícitos (exactamente dos personajes cobran vida; solo se muestra una sola mano/antebrazo; sin texto/logotipos/marcas de agua; nada se rompe ni se cae) para evitar añadidos no deseados.

fr.content:
Utilisez un prompt Seedance structuré avec des blocs étiquetés comme [SCENE], [REFERENCES], [TECHNICAL], [STRUCTURE], [TIMELINE], [PHYSICS], [LIGHTING], [AUDIO] et [LOCKS] pour contrôler l’histoire, les visuels et les contraintes.

Pour assurer la cohérence des personnages, joignez des images de référence séparées pour chaque personnage et précisez de reproduire uniquement l’apparence à 100 %, en indiquant explicitement à Seedance de ne pas hériter de l’arrière-plan, de l’éclairage ou de la caméra de référence.

Utilisez une image de référence d’environnement séparée uniquement pour la lumière/l’atmosphère (et non pour la géométrie/les objets) afin de conserver la cohérence du décor tout en évitant toute contamination stylistique indésirable.

Verrouillez l’animation sur des canaux de performance spécifiques (yeux, bouche, inclinaison uniquement) et interdisez explicitement la locomotion (ne jamais marcher, sauter ou voler) afin d’empêcher tout mouvement corporel supplémentaire.

Anticipez le montage en précisant le nombre de segments et le type de coupe (par ex. 13 segments, 12 coupes franches) et listez chaque plan avec des timecodes pour imposer le rythme et la continuité.

Contrôlez le langage de caméra en définissant des préréglages exacts de focale/angle pour chaque type de plan (par ex. 84° grand angle, 47° plan moyen à 30–60 cm, 35° gros plan, un macro à 18°) et ajoutez une règle d’absence de zoom.

Prévenez la dérive stylistique en indiquant ce que le rendu n’est PAS (NOT photoreal, NOT live action, NOT stop-motion, NOT illustration, NOT anime) en plus du style recherché (qualité de long-métrage 3D stylisé haut de gamme).

Ajoutez des indications de rendu physiquement basé (soft global illumination, PBR, subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, volumetric light shaft) pour orienter Seedance vers un éclairage et des matériaux CG haut de gamme.

Précisez des règles de physique du mouvement (poids céramique, bascule/retombée avec masse réelle, pas de rebond léger ; oscillation de porte sur charnière avec poids ; volutes de vapeur ; poussière qui dérive) pour obtenir un mouvement secondaire crédible.

Contraignez le monde avec des verrous explicites (exactement deux personnages prennent vie ; une seule main/avant-bras visible ; aucun texte/logo/watermark ; rien ne se casse/ne tombe) afin d’éviter les ajouts indésirables.

ja.content:
[SCENE]、[REFERENCES]、[TECHNICAL]、[STRUCTURE]、[TIMELINE]、[PHYSICS]、[LIGHTING]、[AUDIO]、[LOCKS] のようなラベル付きブロックを使った構造化された Seedance prompt を用いて、ストーリー、ビジュアル、制約を制御します。

キャラクターの一貫性を保つため、キャラクターごとに別々の reference image を添付し、見た目は100%再現のみと指定し、Seedance に reference の背景、ライティング、カメラを継承しないよう明示的に伝えます。

環境の reference image は光と雰囲気のみのために別途用意し（形状やオブジェクトは含めない）、不要なスタイルの混入を防ぎつつセットの一貫性を保ちます。

アニメーションは特定の performance channel（eyes、mouth、tilt のみ）にロックし、locomotion は明確に禁止（歩かない、跳ねない、飛ばない）して、余計な身体動作を防ぎます。

segment 数と cut の種類（例: 13 segments、12 hard cuts）を指定して編集を事前に設計し、各 shot を timestamp 付きで列挙して、テンポと連続性を強制します。

各 shot type ごとに正確な focal/angle preset（例: 84° wide、47° medium at 30–60 cm、35° close、18° macro を1つ）を宣言し、no zooming ルールを追加して camera language を制御します。

望ましい見た目（high-end stylised 3D feature quality）と並べて、それが何ではないか（NOT photoreal、NOT live action、NOT stop-motion、NOT illustration、NOT anime）を明記し、style drift を防ぎます。

soft global illumination、PBR、subsurface scattering、shallow depth of field、volumetric light shaft などの physically based render の手がかりを加えて、Seedance を high-end な CG のライティング／マテリアルへ誘導します。

motion physics のルール（ceramic weight、real mass で rock/settle、no light bouncing、hinge-weight door swing、steam curls、dust drifts）を指定して、説得力のある二次動作を得ます。

explicit locks（exactly two characters come alive、only a single hand/forearm shown、no text/logos/watermarks、nothing breaks/drops）で世界を制約し、不要な追加要素を避けます。

ko.content:
[SCENE], [REFERENCES], [TECHNICAL], [STRUCTURE], [TIMELINE], [PHYSICS], [LIGHTING], [AUDIO], [LOCKS] 같은 라벨이 붙은 구조화된 Seedance prompt를 사용해 스토리, 비주얼, 제약 조건을 제어하세요.

캐릭터 일관성을 위해 캐릭터별로 별도의 reference image를 첨부하고, reproduce 100% appearance only라고 명시한 뒤, Seedance가 reference의 배경, 조명, 카메라를 절대 이어받지 않도록 분명히 지시하세요.

환경 reference image는 조명/분위기용으로만 별도로 사용하고(geometry/objects는 제외), 세트의 일관성은 유지하되 원치 않는 스타일 번짐은 방지하세요.

애니메이션은 특정 performance channel(eyes, mouth, tilt only)에만 고정하고, locomotion은 명시적으로 금지하세요(never walk, hop, or fly). 그래야 불필요한 몸동작을 막을 수 있습니다.

segment count와 cut type(예: 13 segments, 12 hard cuts)을 지정해 편집을 미리 설계하고, 각 shot을 timestamp와 함께 나열해 pacing과 continuity를 강제하세요.

shot type별로 정확한 focal/angle preset(예: 84° wide, 47° medium at 30–60 cm, 35° close, one 18° macro)을 선언하고 no zooming rule을 추가해 카메라 언어를 제어하세요.

원하는 룩(high-end stylised 3D feature quality)과 함께 그것이 무엇이 아닌지(NOT photoreal, NOT live action, NOT stop-motion, NOT illustration, NOT anime)를 명시해 style drift를 방지하세요.

soft global illumination, PBR, subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, volumetric light shaft 같은 physically based render cue를 추가해 Seedance가 고급 CG 조명/재질 쪽으로 가도록 유도하세요.

motion physics 규칙(ceramic weight, rock/settle with real mass, no light bouncing; hinge-weight door swing; steam curls; dust drifts)을 지정해 믿을 만한 secondary motion을 얻으세요.

명시적인 lock(exactly two characters come alive; only a single hand/forearm shown; no text/logos/watermarks; nothing breaks/drops)으로 세계를 제약해 원치 않는 추가 요소를 피하세요.

pt.content:
Use um prompt estruturado do Seedance com blocos rotulados como [SCENE], [REFERENCES], [TECHNICAL], [STRUCTURE], [TIMELINE], [PHYSICS], [LIGHTING], [AUDIO] e [LOCKS] para controlar a história, os visuais e as restrições.

Para consistência dos personagens, anexe imagens de referência separadas para cada personagem e especifique reproduzir 100% apenas da aparência, além de dizer explicitamente ao Seedance para não herdar o fundo, a iluminação ou a câmera da referência.

Use uma imagem de referência separada do ambiente apenas para luz/atmosfera (não geometria/objetos) para manter o cenário consistente enquanto evita contaminação indesejada de estilo.

Trave a animação em canais específicos de performance (olhos, boca, inclinação apenas) e proíba explicitamente a locomoção (nunca andar, pular ou voar) para evitar movimento extra do corpo.

Planeje a edição com antecedência especificando o número de segmentos e o tipo de corte (por exemplo, 13 segmentos, 12 cortes secos) e liste cada plano com timestamps para forçar o ritmo e a continuidade.

Controle a linguagem de câmera declarando presets exatos de distância focal/ângulo por tipo de plano (por exemplo, 84° wide, 47° medium a 30–60 cm, 35° close, um macro de 18°) e adicione uma regra de sem zoom.

Evite deriva de estilo dizendo o que ele NÃO é (NOT photoreal, NOT live action, NOT stop-motion, NOT illustration, NOT anime) junto com o visual desejado (high-end stylised 3D feature quality).

Adicione indicações de renderização fisicamente baseada (soft global illumination, PBR, subsurface scattering, shallow depth of field, volumetric light shaft) para orientar o Seedance em direção a iluminação e materiais CG de alto nível.

Especifique regras de física do movimento (ceramic weight, rock/settle with real mass, no light bouncing; hinge-weight door swing; steam curls; dust drifts) para obter movimento secundário crível.

Restrinja o mundo com locks explícitos (exactly two characters come alive; only a single hand/forearm shown; no text/logos/watermarks; nothing breaks/drops) para evitar adições indesejadas.

zh.content:
使用结构化的 Seedance prompt，并用带标签的区块如 [SCENE]、[REFERENCES]、[TECHNICAL]、[STRUCTURE]、[TIMELINE]、[PHYSICS]、[LIGHTING]、[AUDIO] 和 [LOCKS] 来控制故事、视觉效果和约束。

为了保持角色一致性，为每个角色分别附上参考图像，并明确指定只需 100% 还原外观，同时明确告诉 Seedance 不要继承参考图中的背景、光照或镜头。

使用单独的环境参考图仅用于光线/氛围（不用于几何/物体），以保持场景一致，同时避免不必要的风格串扰。

将动画锁定到特定的表演通道（仅限眼睛、嘴巴、轻微倾斜），并明确禁止位移移动（绝不行走、跳跃或飞行），以防止额外的身体动作。

通过指定分段数量和剪辑类型（例如，13 个片段、12 个硬切）来预先规划剪辑，并列出每个镜头及其时间戳，以强制节奏和连贯性。

通过为每种镜头类型声明精确的焦距/角度预设（例如，84° 广角、47° 中景，距离 30–60 cm、35° 近景、一个 18° 微距）来控制镜头语言，并加入禁止变焦的规则。

通过说明它“不是什么”来防止风格漂移（NOT photoreal、NOT live action、NOT stop-motion、NOT illustration、NOT anime），同时明确所需风格（high-end stylised 3D feature quality）。

添加基于物理渲染的提示（soft global illumination、PBR、subsurface scattering、shallow depth of field、volumetric light shaft），引导 Seedance 朝向高端 CG 的光照与材质表现。

指定运动物理规则（ceramic weight、rock/settle with real mass、no light bouncing；hinge-weight door swing；steam curls；dust drifts），以获得可信的次级运动。

用明确的锁定条件约束世界（exactly two characters come alive；only a single hand/forearm shown；no text/logos/watermarks；nothing breaks/drops），以避免不必要的新增内容。
